say:1:1430251501:1.text: The nobles that have been using the Divine Dew the longest have grown dragon scales on their faces.
say:1:1430251501:1.source_cn: 贵族们服用恩典灵露最多最久，所以脸上才会长出龙鳞。
say:1:1430251501:1.male: The nobles that have been using the Divine Dew the longest have grown dragon scales on their faces.
say:1:1430251501:1.female: The nobles that have been using the Divine Dew the longest have grown dragon scales on their faces.

say:2:1430251502:1.text: No wonder all the nobles wore veils...
say:2:1430251502:1.source_cn: 难怪整个萨洛克兰之中，只有贵族才会佩戴面纱……
say:2:1430251502:1.male: No wonder all the nobles wore veils...
say:2:1430251502:1.female: No wonder all the nobles wore veils...
